title: FlipDD: know who is across the table

scenes.visual: Frame 0 full: 'Next meeting · Creandum' card. Red line to Lovable on 'already', stamp 'BACKED LOVABLE, FEB 2025' on 'competitor'. Second line types: That's normal. Walking in blind isn't.

lines.text: Your next investor already backed your competitor. That's normal. Walking in blind isn't.

scenes.visual: Snowy Slush hall. Two columns of kinetic type: what the investor knows vs what the founder knows.

lines.text: They know your market and your rival's numbers. Most founders walk in knowing a name.

scenes.visual: Full red, FlipDD mark flips, tagline.

lines.text: FlipDD flips the due diligence. Check your investors back, before the meeting.
lines.say: Flip-D-D flips the due diligence. Check your investors back, before the meeting.

scenes.visual: Footage of tryflipdd.vercel.app/app: Load example, Check, verdict cards fill from Cala records cached today; header shows the counts.

lines.text: Paste your meeting list and your competitor. FlipDD walks the Cala graph: over a hundred records, in seconds.
lines.say: Paste your meeting list and your competitor. Flip-D-D walks the Kahla graph: over a hundred records, in seconds.

scenes.visual: Rows: Creandum (Backs your competitor), Northzone (One step away via Accel), Atomico (Lookalike).

lines.text: Every tie, sourced. Creandum backed Lovable. Northzone co-invests with Accel, Lovable's lead. Others hold a lookalike.

scenes.visual: Prep panel on Creandum: In 30 seconds card, then Who you'll meet (Sabina Wizander), then Lovable's ARR and headcount bars.

lines.text: Then tap Prep. Who's likely across the table, and what they did before. What they already know about Lovable: seventeen million in revenue to seventy-five. What to ask, and what to hold back.

scenes.visual: Phone: Telegram /prep Creandum, note and a voice note arrive (owner's screen recording placeholder). Then the call mark rings: phone line placeholder.

lines.text: Between meetings, it's on your phone. Ask the Telegram bot, and the note comes back as a voice note.
Creandum. Expect the comparison. Likely across the table: Sabina Wizander, Partner.
Every fact comes from Cala, with its source.
lines.say: Every fact comes from Kahla, with its source.
